title: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For ea
question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    composition,
    index_value
  FROM interest_metrics
  WHERE (_year = 2018 AND _month >= 9)
     OR (_year = 2019 AND _month <= 8)
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    AVG(composition / index_value) AS avg_comp
  FROM base
  GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    avg_comp,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_comp DESC) AS rn
  FROM monthly
),
top AS (
  SELECT
    month_year,
    interest_id,
    avg_comp AS max_index_composition
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
rolling AS (
  SELECT
    month_year,
    max_index_composition,
    AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (
      ORDER BY month_year
      ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS rolling_avg
  FROM top
)
SELECT
  r.month_year AS date,
  im.interest_name AS interest_name,
  r.max_index_composition AS max_index_composition,
  r.rolling_avg AS rolling_avg,
  im1.interest_name AS interest_name_1mo_ago,
  t1.max_index_composition AS max_index_composition_1mo_ago,
  im2.interest_name AS interest_name_2mo_ago,
  t2.max_index_composition AS max_index_composition_2mo_ago
FROM rolling r
JOIN top t0 ON t0.month_year = r.month_year
LEFT JOIN top t1 ON t1.month_year = strftime('%m-%Y', date(r.month_year || '-01', '-1 month'))
LEFT JOIN top t2 ON t2.month_year = strftime('%m-%Y', date(r.month_year || '-01', '-2 month'))
LEFT JOIN interest_map im ON im.id = t0.interest_id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im1 ON im1.id = t1.interest_id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im2 ON im2.id = t2.interest_id
ORDER BY r.month_year
